name: Blossoming Self
source:
On a seemingly normal day at school, Ren Lyons receives a love confession a girl who has been eyeing him for sometime, but proceeds to reject her confession? After some time reflecting on it, Ashton Mills transfers to his class and the two begin to form a friendship... and maybe something more? 

This prompts Ren to question his sexuality and identity, beginning his journey of self discovery. With the help of his friends, he begins to unearth these new thoughts and feelings, piece by piece, and comes to terms with them through self-expression and acceptance! 

[From [url=https://atomicpsythe.itch.io/blossomingself]itch.io[/url]]
